# hri_server (Resource)

Adopts an existing dedicated server into Terraform state. This resource does not create or modify Robot servers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers { hri = { source = "withlogicco/hri" } }
}
provider "hri" {}
resource "hri_server" "containership_01" { server_number = 161051 }

data "hri_servers" "all" {}

locals {
  tracked   = toset([hri_server.containership_01.server_number])
  untracked = setsubtract(data.hri_servers.all.server_numbers, local.tracked)
}

check "all_servers_tracked" {
  assert {
    condition     = length(local.untracked) == 0
    error_message = "Untracked Hetzner servers: ${join(", ", local.untracked)}"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_number` (Number) Robot server number. Changing this value replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `cancelled` (Boolean) Whether cancellation is active.
- `dc` (String) Robot data center.
- `ips` (List of String) Single IP addresses assigned to the server.
- `paid_until` (String) Date through which the server is paid.
- `product` (String) Robot product name.
- `server_ip` (String) Main server IPv4 address.
- `server_ipv6_net` (String) Main server IPv6 network.
- `server_name` (String) Server name reported by Robot.
- `status` (String) Server status reported by Robot.
- `subnets` (List of String) Assigned subnets in CIDR notation.
- `traffic` (String) Included traffic quota.
